name: Hegemony Corridor Lock
description: A navigation lock pulled from the wreck of a Hegemony survey tender. It still holds a fix on the corridor where the Hegemony keeps its doctrine of armour and attrition.

name: Tri-Tachyon Corridor Key
description: A Tri-Tachyon navigation lock, sold quietly by a contractor who left the company on bad terms. It holds the fix on the corridor where the corporation keeps its phase and energy work.

name: Pilgrim's Wayfinder
description: A worn navigation lock carried by Luddic pilgrim haulers, its casing scratched with prayers. It points the way into the corridor where the Church keeps its plain, stubborn engineering.

name: Raider Run Lock
description: A navigation lock prised out of a raider's helm. Pirates trade these fixes like treasure maps, each one a back way into the corridor where they keep their salvage tricks.

name: League Charter Lock
description: A navigation lock issued under a Persean League shipping charter, its registry seal still intact. It holds the fix on the corridor where the League yards keep their designs.

name: Diktat Lighthouse Key
description: A navigation lock stamped with the Lion of Sindria and the Diktat's security codes. It holds the fix on the corridor where the Diktat keeps its fuel and fleet work.

name: Unlisted Navigation Lock
description: A navigation lock recovered from a derelict that should not have been flying. Its fix points into a corridor no living crew charted.

name: Kesteven Proving Lock
description: A navigation lock from a Kesteven test range, still logged to a prototype that never came home. It holds the fix on the corridor where Kesteven's research division keeps its prototype modspecs.

name: Enigma Lock
description: A navigation lock of no known make, found drifting with no ship around it. Its fix points into a corridor nobody claims.

name: Nightcross Lock
description: A navigation lock cut from a Nightcross wreck, its codes still warm. It holds the fix on the corridor where Nightcross keeps its techniques.

name: Stargazer Lock
description: A navigation lock salvaged after a Stargazer fleet broke apart. Its fix points into the corridor where the Stargazers keep what they learned.

name: Abyssal Lock
description: A navigation lock reverse engineered from the wreckage of an Abyssal construct. Its fix leads down into the corridor of the Abyss.

name: Hyper-Nav Beacon
description: A portable beacon of Exo-Tech make, built to guide the Exoship's warp drive. Set in a socket, it gives the Exoship a fix to dock with, and with it a way into Exo-Tech's hull modifications.
